en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural church complex with low, tiled-roof buildings surrounded by a wall and gate. A larger, two‑storey structure with a hipped roof rises in the center. In the foreground is an open, rough field with a few people and animals. At the top of the postcard are French captions: on the left, 'Environs de Salonique' and on the right, 'L'ÉGLISE DE DUDULAR'. At the bottom right, a modern watermark reads 'www.elia.org.gr'.
